messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (locked meaning) | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------------------------|--------------------|-------------------|--------| | **ove** | locative subordinator “where” the event occurs | जहाँ | “where” | OK | | **udirai** | future action of the addressee: will hear | सुनोगे | “you will hear” | OK | | **le** | definite article, feminine plural | — (omitted) | (none) | UNNECESSARY | | **disperate** | adjective qualifying the shrieks as desperate | निराशाजनक | “despairing” | OK | | **strida** | plural noun, the audible shrieks | चीत्कार | “shrieks” | OK | | **vedrai** | future action of the addressee: will see | देखोगे | “you will see” | OK | | **li** | definite article, masculine plural | — (omitted) | (none) | UNNECESSARY | | **antichi** | adjective indicating ancient age | प्राचीन | “ancient” | OK | | **spiriti** | plural noun, the spirits | आत्माओं | “spirits” | OK | | **dolenti** | adjective describing the spirits as woeful | दुःखी | “woeful” | OK | | **ch’** (che) | relative pronoun introducing clause about the spirits | जो | “who” | OK | | **a** | preposition marking direction/toward | के लिये | “for / toward” | OK | | **la** | definite article, feminine singular | — (omitted) | (none) | UNNECESSARY | | **seconda** | ordinal adjective: the second (death) | **दूसरे** | “second” (masc.) | **GRAMMAR** (gender mismatch – should be *दूसरी* to agree with *मृत्यु*) | | **morte** | noun, death, the object of the preposition | मृत्यु | “death” | OK | | **ciascun** | distributive quantifier: each | प्रत्येक | “each” | OK | | **grida** | verb: each spirit shouts/ cries out | **चिल्लाएगा** | “will shout” (sg.) | **GRAMMAR** (number mismatch – subject is plural, should be *चिल्लाएंगे*) |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *le*, *li*, *la* (Italian articles naturally omitted in Hindi). - **GRAMMAR**: - *seconda* → target **दूसरे** (should be **दूसरी** to match feminine *मृत्यु*). - *grida* → target **चिल्लाएगा** (should be **चिल्लाएंगे** to agree with plural subject).
No tokens are missing or incorrectly translated beyond the noted grammatical mismatches.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 115** - Original: जहाँ तुम निराशाजनक चीत्कार सुनोगे, - Issue: none - Corrected: जहाँ तुम निराशाजनक चीत्कार सुनोगे,
- **Line 116** - Original: तुम प्राचीन दुःखी आत्माओं को देखोगे, - Issue: none - Corrected: तुम प्राचीन दुःखी आत्माओं को देखोगे,
- **Line 117** - Original: जो प्रत्येक दूसरे मृत्यु के लिये चिल्लाएगा; - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – adjective “second” must agree with feminine “मृत्यु” (दूसरी), and verb must agree with plural subject (चिल्लाएंगे). - Corrected: जो प्रत्येक दूसरी मृत्यु के लिये चिल्लाएंगे;
``` जहाँ तुम निराशाजनक चीत्कार सुनोगे, तुम प्राचीन दुःखी आत्माओं को देखोगे, जो प्रत्येक दूसरी मृत्यु के लिये चिल्लाएंगे; ```
